subject: Green Line Transit Area Parking Zone Pilot
overview: The Commission approved a controversial one-year pilot program for a unified 'GL Zone' in South Medford to manage resident parking near Green Line stations. The body also authorized several residential parking variances, established no-parking safety zones at two intersections, and approved new bike lanes on Grove Street.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the February Traffic Commission meeting.

items.title: GLX Parking Zone Pilot
items.summary: Approved a one-year pilot for a unified resident parking zone in South Medford near transit stations, amending the motion to include quarterly public review sessions. Numerous residents expressed concerns regarding displacement of cars to neighboring streets, impacts on residents with limited off-street options, and the current lack of enforcement.

items.title: Handicap Space Relocation at 42 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Approved moving a handicap parking space to a nearby non-metered corner location.

items.title: Residential Parking Variances
items.summary: Approved variances allowing residents of 96 College Avenue, 9 Edwards Place, and 48 Winthrop Street to obtain permits for adjacent side streets due to lack of parking on their primary addresses.

items.title: Commercial Vehicle Parking at 11 Walcart
items.summary: Tabled this item because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: No Parking Safety Zone at Fulton Street and Maple Park Avenue
items.summary: Approved a 30-foot no-parking zone on the west side of Fulton Street to improve sight lines for vehicles exiting Maple Park Avenue.

items.title: No Parking Safety Zone at Bradshaw and Spring Streets
items.summary: Approved a 40-foot no-parking zone from the corner of Spring Street to prevent unsafe parking that obstructs two-way travel.

items.title: Grove Street Bike Lanes
items.summary: Approved striping five-foot bicycle lanes in both directions on Grove Street from the Winchester line to north of Bustle Road by narrowing travel lanes.

items.title: Traffic Commission Operating Procedures
items.summary: Discussed drafting formal operating procedures for the body to clarify staff roles and public notification requirements; the Chair and Commissioner Hunt will collaborate on a draft.

items.title: Visitor Passes for 215 Harvard Street
items.summary: Tabled a request regarding visitor passes for Lincoln-Kennedy Condo residents to allow for the location and review of historical agreements signed by a previous mayor.
